content.short: XSTAR is an omnichain identity protocol for Proof of Humanity.
content.description: XSTAR offers Proof of Humanity as a Service to projects that need to confirm their users are real. The service validates real human identities while guarding against AI-generated duplicates, using an adaptive omnichain humanity scoring system that evolves as AI capabilities advance. Designed for cross-chain environments, it provides ongoing, credible identity checks across multiple networks, helping platforms deter impersonation and strengthen trusted user verification.

resources.title: Scoring Humanity Instead of Proving It Once
resources.tldr: Biometrics, social graph and offline attendance combined into an adaptive score, with zero-knowledge proofs keeping the inputs private.

resources.title: One Name Across Every Chain
resources.tldr: A readable identifier that resolves on L1 and L2 alike, carried between them by LayerZero and Axelar rather than redeployed per chain.
